desc: Online co-op, a guest whose own file is an open-world one (TTYD_OPEN_SEED) joins a host on a plain file in Rogueport's harbour (gor_00, where the seed moves an item): as it takes the host's progress its room is entered again, so the area's items are the host's file's, not its seed's, and no room drift is found (0.5.1 before: the seed's item stayed in the guest's copy of the room, "an item here is gone there", a DRIFT: nm51f l51-024)

log_must: co-op: gor_00 entered again as the host's file has it
log_must_not: room: item .* gone here in gor_00: sent
